title: Governance Drift in AI-Assisted Workflows: Role-Separated Drift Comparison (RSDC) v0.11.1
description: A claim-disciplined framework and public working-paper package for detecting governance drift in AI-assisted workflows using role separation, receipt-based review, claim-boundary enforcement, and proposed relational-continuity drift tests. Status: working paper / proposed framework; no empirical validation claimed.
notes: Claim-boundary note: This release does not certify AI safety, alignment, consciousness, trustworthiness, clinical usefulness, legal compliance, or empirical validation. The transcript corpus that motivated the relational-continuity extension is illustrative and not evidence. The corpus is not the evidence; the corpus is the reason T9-T11 exist.
